sources.license: Facts: public standard identifiers and conversion formulas; names/units written by the project (no standard text copied)
sources.notes: All 15 PID formulas cross-checked 2026-11-27 against Wikipedia OBD-II_PIDs (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OBD-II_PIDs), SAE J1979 slide deck on slideshare.net, csselectronics.com and x-engineer.org. Still verify against purchased SAE J1979 before production.

sources.name: SAE J2012 / ISO 15031-6 generic DTC codes
sources.license: Code numbers are standardized identifiers; descriptions are original project paraphrases (not copied from any source)
sources.notes: Batch pass 2026-11-27 for 15 codes (P0100,P0101,P0105,P0110,P0115,P0120,P0130,P0172,P0335,P0340,P0442,P0455,P0500,P0505,P0562) against edmunds.com/obd-dtc, iatn.net DTC index pages and a generic-DTC list (scribd 'OBDII Generic DTC Definitions Guide'). Per-code original wording was not recorded in that pass. Variance to review: for P0105 the iatn samples label it as a MAP sensor performance fault, while the generic list says MAP/BARO circuit malfunction; the stored description follows the generic list (range/performance is a separate code, P0106). Verify against SAE J2012 before production.

sources.name: Hyundai TSB 16-FL-004 (NHTSA) - P0171
sources.license: Manufacturer technical bulletin / US government document hosted by NHTSA; only the short code label is quoted, no other text copied
sources.notes: Original wording (Hyundai TSB 16-FL-004): 'System too Lean - Bank 1'. Variants: FCA bulletin MC-10215122-9999 (https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2016/MC-10215122-9999.pdf) writes 'System Too Lean (Bank 1)'; carwhere.com/obd-codes/p0171 and engineerfix.com attribute the same title to SAE J2012 (secondary). Differences are punctuation/capitalisation only; stored as 'System too lean (bank 1)' (the earlier 'Fuel system' prefix was dropped to match). Caveat: the FCA bulletin describes a diesel calibration where P0171 is remapped to P026C, so OEM/engine-specific remapping exists; this entry is the generic OBD-II meaning. Not checked against the SAE J2012 text (paywalled).

sources.name: Audi TSB 01-16-60 (NHTSA) - P0300
sources.license: Manufacturer technical bulletin / US government document hosted by NHTSA; only the short code label is quoted, no other text copied
sources.notes: Original wording (Audi TSB, 2016-04-20): 'Random/Multiple Cylinder Misfire Detected'. Variants: another OEM bulletin (SB-10099235-2532) uses a shorter 'random misfire' label; O'Reilly Auto Parts writes 'Random or Multiple'. Same meaning (misfire not tied to one cylinder). Not checked against SAE J2012 text.

sources.name: Edmunds OBD-II code P0301
sources.license: Short code label quoted for identification only; no other text copied. Site terms apply to the site's own content.
sources.notes: Original wording (Edmunds): 'Cylinder 1 Misfire Detected'. OEM corroboration: Audi bulletin SB-10093297-0699 abbreviates it as Cyl.1; Kelley Blue Book (kbb.com/obd-ii/p0300) lists P0301 with the same cylinder-1 meaning. Variants are abbreviation only. Not checked against SAE J2012 text.

sources.name: OEM bulletin SB-10099730-2532 (NHTSA) - P0302
sources.license: Manufacturer technical bulletin / US government document hosted by NHTSA; only the short code label is quoted, no other text copied
sources.notes: Original wording (OEM bulletin, 2014): 'Cylinder No.2 misfire detected'. Variants: 'Cylinder 2' (KBB, Edmunds family) and 'Cyl.2' (Audi bulletin). 'No.' / 'Cyl.' are cosmetic differences. Not checked against SAE J2012 text.

sources.name: OEM bulletin SB-10099235-2532 (NHTSA) - P0303
sources.license: Manufacturer technical bulletin / US government document hosted by NHTSA; only the short code label is quoted, no other text copied
sources.notes: Original wording (OEM bulletin, 2015): 'Cylinder No.3 misfire detected'. Variants: 'Cylinder 3' (KBB) and 'Cyl.3' (Audi bulletin). Cosmetic differences only. Not checked against SAE J2012 text.

sources.name: OEM bulletin MC-10239677-0001 (NHTSA) - P0304
sources.license: Manufacturer technical bulletin / US government document hosted by NHTSA; only the short code label is quoted, no other text copied
sources.notes: Original wording (OEM bulletin, 2023): 'Cyl.4 Misfire Detected'. Variants: 'Cylinder 4' (KBB, Edmunds family), 'Cylinder No.4' (other OEM bulletin). Cosmetic differences only. Not checked against SAE J2012 text.

sources.name: Subaru TSB 09-124-24 (NHTSA) - P0420
sources.license: Manufacturer technical bulletin / US government document hosted by NHTSA; only the short code label is quoted, no other text copied
sources.notes: Original wording (Subaru TSB, 2024-07-01): 'Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold Bank 1'. Variants: Audi bulletin MC-10228406-9999 puts 'Bank 1' before 'Efficiency'; Hyundai bulletin SB-10082702-0699 says 'Catalytic Converter System' instead of 'Catalyst System'; Identifix writes '(Bank 1)' in parentheses. Same meaning. Note: this code does not prove the converter is faulty (diagnostic hint only). Not checked against SAE J2012 text.

sources.name: NHTSA investigation resume PE12-017 - U0100
sources.license: Manufacturer technical bulletin / US government document hosted by NHTSA; only the short code label is quoted, no other text copied
sources.notes: Original wording (NHTSA INRD PE12-017 DTC table): 'Lost Communication With ECM/PCM "A"'. Variants: GM bulletin SB-10043829-6448 drops the "A" designator; GM bulletin MC-10180304-9999 says 'Engine Control Module'. The "A" distinguishes it from ECM/PCM "B" (U0115). Stored as 'Lost communication with ECM/PCM A'. Not checked against SAE J2012 text.

sources.name: NHTSA investigation resume EA17-004 - U0121
sources.license: Manufacturer technical bulletin / US government document hosted by NHTSA; only the short code label is quoted, no other text copied
sources.notes: Original wording (NHTSA INRD EA17-004 DTC table): 'Lost Communication With Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) Control Module'. Variants: GM bulletin SB-10043829-6448 shortens to 'ABS Control Module'; GM bulletin MC-10180304-9999 says 'Electronic Brake Control Module'. Same module. Not checked against SAE J2012 text.

sources.name: B0001 evidence summary (UNCHECKED, OEM-specific wording)
sources.license: Manufacturer technical bulletin / US government document hosted by NHTSA; only the short code label is quoted, no other text copied
sources.notes: UNCHECKED. Reason: wording is manufacturer-dependent and the fault type is carried in a suffix. One OEM bulletin (TOPIx system, SB-10056433-5627) uses the base title 'Driver Frontal Stage 1 Deployment Control' with suffixes (-11 short to ground, -12 short to battery, -13 open, -2B cross-coupled); another OEM bulletin (MC-11033141-0001) labels the same code number with 'Ignition Loop' wording instead. Not applied as a generic definition (is_generic=false); suffix sub-faults are not stored. Needs the SAE J2012 text or per-manufacturer entries.

sources.name: C0035 evidence summary (UNCHECKED, OEM-specific)
sources.license: Manufacturer technical bulletin / US government document hosted by NHTSA; only the short code label is quoted, no other text copied
sources.notes: UNCHECKED. Reason: manufacturer-specific. A GM bulletin (MC-10173400-9999, 2020) lists 'C0035: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit'; Kelley Blue Book reports that some GM vehicles label C0035 as a right-front supply fault; other sites call it GM-defined. Not applied as a generic definition (is_generic=false). Needs the SAE J2012 text or per-manufacturer entries (GM is not yet in the manufacturers table).
